task.title: P6-067: Decide whether custom gap components get a component-gap-analysis entry
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 6 — Decisions the maintainer owns). Original id: P6-067. Size: S, decision first. Specs: specs/ui-components.md.

**Do custom gap components get a `design/component-gap-analysis.md` entry at all?** The `vendor-component` skill asks for deviations to be recorded there, but the selection tray is a custom component with no upstream to deviate from — and the analysis already records `action_bar` as ruled out (`:45`, `:101`), so the tray's absence is arguably correct. The skill never says "vendored components only" (`:17`, `:28`, `:64`). Decide, then edit whichever of the two is wrong.
